t: What to learn first (B1 to B4)
k: Just press the glowing buttons in order. Take your time and read each step. Traps are placed on the tiles above, below, left and right of Lily. After placing one, "wait" for the enemy to come. Placing a trap, walking and waiting each take one turn. Each time Lily acts once, the enemies act once. You learn to hold an enemy first and then run ahead to place a trap. Use the clapper trap on fleeing enemies. The last practice floor is about COMBO and CHAIN. Hard-shelled enemies can only be defeated by combos (see Basic Systems ).

Before choosing a floor, pick the traps to bring in "Gear & Upgrades". How many kinds you can bring is set by your loadout slots (see Features by Floor ). On the stage details, check the enemies and the recommended traps . On a floor with a new enemy, bring traps that suit it. Tap an enemy to see, in colour, the tiles it can walk to and how many steps it takes (up to 12 steps). It helps you decide where to place traps. Defeat every enemy and the goal opens. After clearing, check the missions (3 per floor). Completing them pays gems and EXP.

t: B5 to B10: you collect your tools
k: From B5, enemy hits get heavier. Get armor at the Armor Shop to raise your HP. Your max HP is the starting 120 plus whatever the armor you wear adds. When you pull a trap you already own, use "stock-up" or "level-up" to make it stronger. Even with only one trap, a bigger stock lets you place more of it in one run. When you clear B8, head to the Cave. It pays gems and EXP 3 times a day (see Daily Routine ). The boss of B10, Great Burrow Bear, does not move until it notices Lily. Place traps along its path before you get close. Standing behind a rock pillar avoids its sweeping attack. Clear B10 and stacked placing and Hard Mode open.

t: B11 to B20: new kinds of enemies
k: Flying enemies appear. Ground traps do not hit flying enemies. Bring them down with the bird-lime net and ground traps work. If your trap level is low, holding and luring may fail on, or last shorter on, high-level enemies. A "?" or "nT" above an enemy's head means your trap level is too low. Level your traps up (see the Glossary & FAQ ). Low walls and puddles let you deal with walking and flying enemies separately (see the terrain in Basic Systems ). Floors just before a boss, such as B19, have many enemies. Wide-area traps and stacked placing help. Ads can also heal you or revive you (see the Glossary & FAQ ). k: Waterside enemies appear. Some move through the water, and some attack from it. You can slowly raise your loadout slots with Cave and Hard Mode rewards (see Features by Floor ). Before the boss, collect EXP from missions and the Cave and level up your traps and armor (see the Upgrade Tables ). t: What is the difference between COMBO and CHAIN?
k: COMBO is "how many traps triggered in the same turn". CHAIN is "how many turns in a row the same enemy was caught by traps". COMBO is counted within one turn however many enemies there are, and CHAIN is counted per enemy. They trigger together and their multipliers multiply. See the tables in Basic

k: Increase the gems of a clear. Heal: 50% of max HP, up to 3 times per floor. Speed boost: your moves become faster than the enemies'. It lasts 40 moves, once per floor. Revive (see above). 2 more rewarded Cave runs. If an ad cannot be loaded, nothing happens.

k: On the in-game gacha screen under "Rates & lineup". The Gacha page of this site shows the same values: the share of each rarity and the list of traps and armor, using the chances for your reached stage. Within one rarity, every item has the same chance.

t: How many times a day can I play the Cave?
k: 3 rewarded runs a day, and 2 more if you watch an ad. After that it is practice. See Daily Routine for details.

t: What is skipping in the Cave?
k: It is available after clearing B30. It uses one rewarded run and counts floor 1 up to your record as cleared without playing them. Your record does not move.

t: What happens if I step on my own trap?
k: Many traps trigger even when you step on them. See the trap's own page. Area traps can hit Lily too. There is also a mission to clear a floor without stepping on your own traps.

t: Can I keep my save when I change phones?
k: If you link your Google account in Settings, you can continue after deleting the app or changing phones. A prompt to link appears as you progress through the story.

t: When can I use Lily's House?
k: After you clear B30 the living room opens. See the Lily's House page for details.
